svg.title: VisionIQ 02 - Four-phase workflow
svg.text: Runs by default when a ticket is picked up: history in, a brief for every ticket, a PR for every defect that can be verified safely, a human at the end.
Aligned to Master Design v1.11 — §2.1, §3.5, §5.3, Appendix A
• Name the root cause behind each
• Do / don't from past fixes and
• Bounded patch in the right layer
• Same test passes, plus history regressions,
• Draft PR: defect → cause → risk → fix
Cannot verify safely → stop and escalate
• Accepts or adjusts each advice item
• Branch policy and CI stay with Azure
Decisions and verified outcomes update Learn — approval is not proof of correctness
Fast path: the brief never waits for patching, CI or benchmarks. The defect deep path is queued separately.
